messages:
jordan: heads-up, i'm doing a pass on the Console Observability migration guide. found two items we should fix before the next docs deploy:

1) the Go SDK snippet uses the old TraceHook API name `trace_key` instead of the new header mapping.
2) the dashboard JSON example references `cost.breakdown.v1` metric which we've renamed to `cost.unit.v2` in telemetry.

anya: thanks. can you paste the snippets?

jordan: here are the problematic bits from the draft:

```
// Go SDK (old)
opts := client.Options{
  TraceHook: "trace_key",
}
```

and in the dashboard sample:

```
{
  "metric": "cost.breakdown.v1",
  "group_by": ["session_id"]
}
```

li: easy wins. new Go snippet should use headers map and the new header name. e.g.

```
// Go SDK (updated)
opts := client.Options{
  Headers: map[string]string{
    "x-redwood-tracekey": trace.ID,
  },
}
```

sam: and dashboard snippet: change metric to `cost.unit.v2` and add a short migration note about aggregation changes (per-token -> per-unit). i'll draft that sentence.

jordan: also add a tiny compatibility table in the migration guide showing old->new metric names and example queries. that'll save follow-ups.

anya: agree. can we also add a one-line note in the SDK changelog snippet to call out header normalization (lowercase) so folks using proxies don't lose the header?

li: i'll open a docs PR with the three patches: Go snippet, dashboard JSON, and changelog callout. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9320 (WIP)

devrel-bot: lint check queued for PR 9320. linkcheck will run after pushes.

sam: while you're there, can you add the Python snippet parity? small snippet:

```
# Python SDK
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, headers={"x-redwood-tracekey": trace.id})
```

li: added python snippet and the compatibility table. pushed.

devrel-bot: linkcheck found two redirects: https://docs.internal/redwood/old-metrics -> 301 to /telemetry/migrations; please update absolute link to the canonical path.

jordan: changed links to /telemetry/migrations in the PR. left a short paragraph clarifying that queries should switch to the new metric and include a sample flux/promql snippet.

anya: timeline? we want this live before the analytics export runs on Monday.

li: aiming to merge today. will ask @sam to run a doc preview check after CI.

sam: will run preview and smoke test dashboards. if green i'll trigger `make docs-deploy` after merge.

devrel-bot: CI passed. previews available: https://preview.docs.redwood/9320

li: merged and deployed the docs site.

sam: verified dashboard renders and alerts behaved as expected in the smoke window. no regressions.

jordan: nice work all, thanks for the quick turnaround :tada:
